chunks: And from him, from some of our companions, he elevated it from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of eating suhoor and breaking fast with water according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the profound physical and spiritual sustenance of *suhoor* (pre-dawn meal), asserting that its inclusion provides sufficient strength for continuous fasting (*siyam al-dahr*). This highlights the Shia scholarly view that *suhoor* is not merely a ritual but a vital source of *barakah* (blessing) and endurance, making voluntary or extended fasting more accessible to the believer.
